reviewContext.issueReference: audit-round-9 feat/ai-capture@aede81d4f21f42d701a081bc1e80e29ae4f5524e (base 0a35708): performance-cad-containment-perimeter-rescans, function-mcp-inline-image-replaced-before-readback; no GitHub issue; workflowInput.requestedOutcome is the issue body
reviewContext.userProblem: The round-9 audit found two defects in CAD capture and MCP delivery. First, CAD capture preparation walks the whole enclosing perimeter for every hole twice, once for sketch depth in packages/core/src/cad/loops.ts and once for selected-ancestor normalisation in packages/core/src/capture/scene.ts, so H holes in a plate of H+3 edges cost H(H+3) edge reads per pass (67,133,440 at 8,192 holes) in TypeScript before Rust renders, in Boa for the native CLI and in the desktop webview. Second, both MCP servers (apps/cli/src/mcp.ts and apps/cli/native/src/mcp.rs) build the inline image by reopening the output path after the capture, so a concurrent capture to the same path can give call A call B's image together with A's report.
requiredOutcomes: performance-cad-containment-perimeter-rescans (R9-1; car9-p1, car9-p2): an internal packages/core/src/cad/edge-y-index.ts edge Y-interval index is built lazily once per contour per pass and queried by loops.ts contains() and scene.ts containsPoint(), each keeping its exact predicate; detailed-rim tests (H = 256/512/1024) show positive builds/visits/inspections counters, builds <= total edges, inspections <= 4H and total growth <= 2.5x per doubling; depths, oracle equality and scene bytes unchanged; existing tests pass unedited.

function-mcp-inline-image-replaced-before-readback (R9-2; car9-p3, car9-p4): each inline MCP response carries the bytes its own successful write stored (written or identical; at most 1,048,576 bytes, else only the length); two-writer regressions with equal-length distinct images fail at stage 1 (readback, A receives B) and pass after the fix in Bun and native; exit 1, identical, failed-write suppression, 1,048,576 / 1,048,577 boundaries, MIME types, structuredContent and exit codes unchanged; native bytes stay in Rust and out of CommandResult.
nonGoals: No change to CadLoop, buildLoops/buildProfileLoops signatures and results, LoopStats existing fields, normaliseToolLoops results, prepareCadCapture, NCS1, goldens, or callers (pcb-outline.ts, history.ts, cad-request.ts, capture-cad.ts, export-handlers.ts).

No change to CommandResult, engine::run signature, files.rs, native-engine.ts, capture-command.ts, mcp-image.ts, tool schemas, instruction texts or note texts; docs/capture.md and design docs are not edited by any plan.
constraints: AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, strict typing, noUncheckedIndexedAccess-safe indexed reads, Biome clean on touched files, CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true.
artifactRoots exactly ["target", "tmp/cad3d"]; evidence under tmp/car9-r9/<planId>/; no *.test.ts left under target/ or tmp/.
Per-plan gates are focused; typecheck, lint, mise run verify and the release-binary parity run once at integration.
Timing rule of design 26.2 applies; at most two bun test or cargo test processes at once.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R9-1 uses a max-augmented static tree over edges sorted by lo with a closed stab query.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: O((k + 1) log n) per query for any edge lengths; the closed superset lets each caller keep its exact predicate, endpoint convention and numeric representation.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R9-1 indexes are built lazily once per contour per pass; the passes do not share instances.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: CadLoop must keep its shape; contours rejected by bounds never pay.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R9-2 retains the call's own write (reference in Bun, moved Vec in native) only for inline calls, bounded at 1 MiB.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Ties the attachment to the call without readback and without extra copies or per-byte work in Boa.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R9-2 uses a run seam in Bun and inline_context/take_capture_write in native, staged so the regression first fails on the old readback.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Real renderers cannot produce equal-length distinct images on demand; staging makes the pre-fix failure functional.

intentionalTradeoffs: The 2.5 growth bound includes a log factor (expected about 2.1 to 2.3).
The existing Bun test's large/unreadable scenarios and reads list, and the existing native inline test fixture, are adapted to per-call assertions (design 27.4).
supportedEdgeCases: Horizontal edges, vertex-on-scanline queries, wrap-around edge 0, contours rejected by bounds, omitted intermediate ancestors; identical outcome, exists outcome, thrown write, exit 1, exactly 1,048,576 and 1,048,577 bytes, JPEG paths, stdout path mismatch.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Boa elapsed time, desktop latency, peak memory, race frequency across real OS processes, Tauri delivery.
